description: Shift live input up or down an octave and mix it with the dry signal for harmonies.

controls.action: Enable audio input and output, then sing or play into the microphone or line input.
Shift pitch in semitones, from −12 to +12.
Dry/wet mix: 100% shifted audio, 0% dry audio.
Reset pitch to 0, the original pitch.
Fine tuning: two cents per step, from −50 to +50 cents.
Toggle dry bypass. Press again to return to pitch shifting.
Listen to dry audio while held; release to return.
Drag left or right to set pitch.

sections.title: Pitch and intervals
sections.text: Twelve semitones make an octave; 100 cents make a semitone. +7 is a perfect fifth up, −5 a perfect fourth down, and ±12 an octave. E3 fine-tunes against another instrument. A middle mix combines dry and shifted audio; 0% passes only the dry input.

sections.title: Key detection
sections.text: The display shows the detected major/minor key and confidence. Twelve bars show pitch-class energy, with the root highlighted. Stable detection avoids rapid switching between related keys. Single notes, drums or noise may show Key unclear. The shifted output key is shown when applicable.

sections.title: Audio and latency
sections.text: Pitch analysis adds latency, roughly 25 ms in this design; actual device I/O adds its own delay. Headphones help prevent feedback. Mixing in dry audio can add body. Large shifts may soften low frequencies.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Pitch, fine tuning, mix, volume and bypass save automatically. Exiting releases audio input and output.
